desc:
Lead your Countryball to world domination! 🌍

Pick your country and its Countryball comes to life — armed, animated and ready to march into battle on a living world map. Grow your borders tile by tile, outsmart rival players and crush them before they crush you.

✈️ AIR WAR — launch fighters from your airfields to defend your skies or strike enemy SAM sites
🚢 NAVAL POWER — send boats to invade other islands, rule the seas with warships, and grow rich with trade ships
🎖️ RANKS — climb from Recruit to legend with every match
⭐ STARS — earn Stars every game and spend them in the Arsenal, Flag Shop and Crates
🏳️ YOUR FLAG — every player fights under their own country's flag

Play solo right in the lobby to learn the ropes, or jump into public matches against real players from around the world.

Will your Countryball rule the world — or get wiped off the map?

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for updates!
